verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is clearly drivable through a documented public API. Subscriptions are created via the Subscriptions API, trials via the Trial Offer API, and usage billing via the Meter Events API reference. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published in the official stripe/openapi repository. Formal dated API versioning and isolated sandboxes support safe programmatic use. The docs-path OpenAPI probe 404s, but the spec is published on GitHub instead, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic Billing API use; the community evidence speaks to pricing rather than API usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.
Meter events represent actions that customers take in your system. You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API
we release new API versions monthly with no breaking changes.
